title: Gate evaluation from satisfied gate clauses
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ assign a truth proposition to every input or gate variable of a tree circuit on $n$ inputs, and let $u$ be a Boolean assignment to its inputs. For a gate label $b$ and a list $cs$ of child circuits, suppose all clauses associated with that gate and child list are satisfied by $\alpha$. Suppose also that each child circuit $c$ evaluates to true under $u$ exactly when $\alpha$ makes its gate variable true. Then the circuit with gate label $b$ and children $cs$ evaluates to true under $u$ exactly when $\alpha$ makes its gate variable true.
hypotheses_covered: A gate label $b$ and child list $cs$
The clauses associated with $b$ and $cs$ are satisfied by $\alpha$
For every child $c$, its evaluation under $u$ agrees with $\alpha$'s truth value for its gate variable
